Definition: from a compound of G4253 and G4098; falling forward, i.e. headlong (figuratively, precipitate):--heady, rash(-ly).
BiblicalUsage: Propetes means falling forward, headlong, precipitate. Luke says the town clerk warned the Ephesians to do nothing rashly, and Paul lists the heady and highminded among the lovers of pleasures in the last days.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rashness is the opposite of wisdom, and the headlong man falls forward into what the quiet man walks around.
